title: Effects
transcript:
A brown paper bag, stapled shut, his number in black marker.
A watch stopped at ten past four. A bus pass. Forty rupees.
And a school notebook with a tiger on the cover. RAMAN VARMA. CLASS V-B.

He carried this in with him. He has carried it everywhere.

Page after page in pencil, pressed hard enough to dent the next sheet:
2.71828 18284 59045 23536 02874 71352 66249 77572 47093 69995

In the margin, underlined three times: after 2718 it goes 2818 28. LEARN IT PARTH.

He says it over until he can say it without looking.
